cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\")
print('Tables:', cur.fetchall())
for table in [r[0] for r in cur.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\").fetchall()]:
    print(f'\n=== {table} ===')
    cur.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info({table})')
    print('Schema:', cur.fetchall())
    cur.execute(f'SELECT * FROM {table}')
    for row in cur.fetchall():
        print(row)
conn.close()
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()

# March 31 reserves
cur.execute(\"SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31'\")
march31_reconstructed = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f'March 31 reconstructed reserves: {march31_reconstructed}')

# March 19 reserves
cur.execute(\"SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-19'\")
march19_reconstructed = cur.fetchone()[0]
print(f'March 19 reconstructed reserves: {march19_reconstructed}')

# Circulation March 19
cur.execute(\"SELECT measure, amount_usdc FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = '2025-03-19'\")
mar19_circ = cur.fetchall()
print(f'March 19 circulation inputs: {mar19_circ}')
march19_circulation = mar19_circ[0][1] - mar19_circ[1][1] - mar19_circ[2][1]
print(f'March 19 circulation: {march19_circulation}')

# Circulation March 31
cur.execute(\"SELECT measure, amount_usdc FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31'\")
mar31_circ = cur.fetchall()
print(f'March 31 circulation inputs: {mar31_circ}')
march31_circulation = mar31_circ[0][1] - mar31_circ[1][1] - mar31_circ[2][1]
print(f'March 31 circulation: {march31_circulation}')

# Reported totals
cur.execute(\"SELECT report_date, reported_total_usd FROM reported_reserve_totals\")
totals = cur.fetchall()
print(f'Reported totals: {totals}')

# Residual
march31_reported = 60040707040
march31_residual = march31_reported - march31_reconstructed
print(f'March 31 residual: {march31_residual}')

# Coverage
mar19_coverage = march19_reconstructed / march19_circulation * 100
mar31_coverage = march31_reconstructed / march31_circulation * 100
print(f'March 19 coverage: {mar19_coverage:.6f}%')
print(f'March 31 coverage: {mar31_coverage:.6f}%')

# Coverage change in bps
coverage_change_bps = (mar31_coverage - mar19_coverage) * 100
print(f'Coverage change (bps): {coverage_change_bps}')

conn.close()
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()

# Test all SQL queries
queries = {
    'march31_reserves_usd': \"SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31'\",
    'march31_circulation_usdc': \"SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN measure = 'total supply' THEN amount_usdc WHEN measure = 'Tokens Allowed But Not Issued' THEN -amount_usdc WHEN measure = 'Access Denied Tokens' THEN -amount_usdc END) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31'\",
    'march31_residual_usd': \"SELECT (SELECT reported_total_usd FROM reported_reserve_totals WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31') - (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-03-31')\",
    'coverage_change_bps': \"SELECT (( (SELECT SUM(rc.amount_usd) FROM reserve_components rc WHERE rc.report_date = '2025-03-31') / (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ci.measure = 'total supply' THEN ci.amount_usdc WHEN ci.measure = 'Tokens Allowed But Not Issued' THEN -ci.amount_usdc WHEN ci.measure = 'Access Denied Tokens' THEN -ci.amount_usdc END) FROM circulation_inputs ci WHERE ci.report_date = '2025-03-31') - (SELECT SUM(rc.amount_usd) FROM reserve_components rc WHERE rc.report_date = '2025-03-19') / (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ci.measure = 'total supply' THEN ci.amount_usdc WHEN ci.measure = 'Tokens Allowed But Not Issued' THEN -ci.amount_usdc WHEN ci.measure = 'Access Denied Tokens' THEN -ci.amount_usdc END) FROM circulation_inputs ci WHERE ci.report_date = '2025-03-19')) * 10000)\"
}

for name, sql in queries.items():
    cur.execute(sql)
    result = cur.fetchone()[0]
    print(f'{name}: {result}')

conn.close()
"

cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()

# Fix: cast to REAL to avoid integer division truncation
sql = '''SELECT ((CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ci.measure = 'total supply' THEN ci.amount_usdc WHEN ci.measure = 'Tokens Allowed But Not Issued' THEN -ci.amount_usdc WHEN ci.measure = 'Access Denied Tokens' THEN -ci.amount_usdc END) AS REAL) / SUM(rc.amount_usd) - 0) FROM reserve_components rc, circulation_inputs ci WHERE rc.report_date = '2025-03-31' AND ci.report_date = '2025-03-31' LIMIT 1'''
# That approach won't work well. Let me use proper subqueries.
sql2 = '''SELECT (
  (SELECT CAST(SUM(rc.amount_usd) AS REAL) FROM reserve_components rc WHERE rc.report_date = '2025-03-31')
  /
  (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ci.measure = 'total supply' THEN ci.amount_usdc WHEN ci.measure = 'Tokens Allowed But Not Issued' THEN -ci.amount_usdc WHEN ci.measure = 'Access Denied Tokens' THEN -ci.amount_usdc END) AS REAL) FROM circulation_inputs ci WHERE ci.report_date = '2025-03-31')
  -
  (SELECT CAST(SUM(rc.amount_usd) AS REAL) FROM reserve_components rc WHERE rc.report_date = '2025-03-19')
  /
  (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ci.measure = 'total supply' THEN ci.amount_usdc WHEN ci.measure = 'Tokens Allowed But Not Issued' THEN -ci.amount_usdc WHEN ci.measure = 'Access Denied Tokens' THEN -ci.amount_usdc END) AS REAL) FROM circulation_inputs ci WHERE ci.report_date = '2025-03-19')
) * 10000'''
cur.execute(sql2)
print(f'coverage_change_bps: {cur.fetchone()[0]}')
conn.close()
"
